_what_this_is: the discover step's proposals (model call); the confirm step looks each up in the registries

proposals.title: Effectiveness of interventions for improving educational outcomes for people with disabilities in low‐ and middle‐income countries: A systematic review
proposals.why: Most recent Campbell systematic review directly answering which interventions improve educational outcomes for people with disabilities in LMICs.

proposals.title: Implementation of Inclusive Education: A Systematic Review of Studies of Inclusive Education Interventions in Low- and Lower-Middle-Income Countries
proposals.container: International Journal of Disability, Development and Education
proposals.why: First systematic review of interventions to improve inclusive education for students with disabilities specifically in low- and lower-middle-income countries.

proposals.title: Teacher professional development for disability inclusion in low‐ and middle‐income Asia‐Pacific countries: An evidence and gap map
proposals.why: Evidence and gap map of 50 studies on teacher professional development for disability-inclusive education in LMIC Asia-Pacific countries.

proposals.title: Evidence and gap map of studies assessing the effectiveness of interventions for people with disabilities in low‐and middle‐income countries
proposals.why: Comprehensive evidence and gap map covering health, education, livelihood, and social outcomes for people with disabilities in LMICs.

proposals.title: Rapid evidence assessment (REA) of what works to improve educational outcomes for people with disabilities in low- and middle-income countries
proposals.container: Campbell Collaboration and International Centre for Evidence in Disability
proposals.why: Rapid evidence assessment commissioned for the 2018 Global Disability Summit; reviews 24 studies on what works for educational outcomes in LMICs.

proposals.title: Inclusive education and children with disabilities: Quality education for all in low and middle income countries
proposals.why: Systematic literature review of 131 peer-reviewed articles on strategies for educational effectiveness for children with disabilities in LMICs.

proposals.title: Policy guidelines on inclusion in education
proposals.why: UNESCO policy guidelines on inclusive education, covering cost-effective measures and policy frameworks for countries with scarce resources.

proposals.title: Inclusion and education (GEM Report 2020)
proposals.why: Global assessment of inclusive education policies and financing, including disability-inclusive education across countries at all income levels.
